title.narrative: Cultural rights for inclusive and equitable Palestinian development process

description.narrative: Overall Objective: To place culture and cultural rights at the heart of Palestinian development policies to ensure citizens centred, inclusive and equitable development process through enabling cultural and touristic community based organizations, clusters, networks and community based organizations, to participate as advocates for the implementation of the ratified Economic Social and Cultural Rights convention and 2030 SDGs targets.Specific ObjectivesEnhance the capacities of cultural and touristic civil society organizations and rural community based organizations as transparent, accountable representatives that reflect the needs of their local communities, including those of women and youth, to influence local decision makers as active planners, managers and owners of their available diverse cultural and touristic resources.Promote and strengthen the enabling environment and space for advocacy initiatives for cultural and touristic civil society organizations, civil society organizations, at national level through the expansion and enhanced capacity of the Network for Palestinian Experiential Organization as a member of the advisory committee for Ministry of Tourism and later for Ministry of Culture. Enhance the capacities of cultural and touristic civil society organizations and civil society organizations to raise public awareness, document violations and promote successes achieved for sustainable cultural rights with human rights based approach to impact decision-making and processes for inclusive cultural rights at local and national levels.
